description: This file contains test utility functions and configuration for models, environment variable management, and mocking in a testing context for the openclaw project.

methods.name: withModelsTempHome
methods.description: Sets up a temporary home directory for models during testing.

methods.name: installModelsConfigTestHooks
methods.description: Installs hooks to reset environment and cache states before and after each test.

methods.name: withTempEnv
methods.description: Temporarily sets environment variables for the duration of a function.

methods.name: withUnsetCopilotTokenEnv
methods.description: Temporarily unsets Copilot token environment variables during a function execution.

methods.name: mockCopilotTokenExchangeSuccess
methods.description: Mocks a successful token exchange response for Copilot.

methods.name: withCopilotGithubToken
methods.description: Sets a Copilot GitHub token environment variable and mocks token exchange.

methods.name: snapshotImplicitProviderEnv
methods.description: Creates a snapshot of specific environment variables related to implicit providers.

methods.name: resolveImplicitProvidersForTest
methods.description: Resolves implicit providers for testing with environment snapshot.
